definitions.gloss: quality of work; result; execution; workmanship
definitions.explanation: How well something is made or done; the quality of the finished product or performance.

examples.japanese: {出来栄|できば}えに{満足|まんぞく}している。
examples.english: I'm satisfied with how it turned out.

examples.japanese: {作品|さくひん}の{出来栄|できば}えを{審査|しんさ}する。
examples.english: To judge the quality of the works.

examples.japanese: {予想|よそう}を{上回|うわまわ}る{出来栄|できば}えで{完成|かんせい}した。
examples.english: It was completed with a result exceeding expectations.

notes:
{出来栄|できば}え emphasizes quality of completion.

FORMS:
- {出来|でき} (completion, result) + {栄|ば}え (flourishing, impressive appearance)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {出来栄|できば}えがいい: turned out well
- {出来栄|できば}えに{満足|まんぞく}する: to be satisfied with the result
- {出来栄|できば}えを{確認|かくにん}する: to check the quality

USAGE:
- Used for crafts, projects, performances, productions
- Focuses on the quality of execution

RELATED WORDS:
- {見栄|みば}え: visual appearance
- {仕上|しあ}がり: finish, completion
- {出来|でき}: result, outcome
